Laboratory findings show leukocytosis (WBC 15,000/μL) without anemia or thrombocytopenia — consistent with bacterial infection. Absence of reported hemoptysis or rust-colored sputum makes *Streptococcus pneumoniae* less likely but does not exclude it; other pathogens (e.g., *Mycoplasma*, *Legionella*, viral) remain possible.
